meta.revision_note_ko: 기운님 피드백 "너무 ai 스럽거나 아이폰 너무예전꺼거나 구도자체가 ai 스러운거는 다시만들자" 반영. AI 화보 키워드(시네마틱·골든아워 역광·보케·8k·masterpiece·perfect skin)를 풀에서 전면 삭제하고, 카메라는 최신 아이폰(15/16 Pro)만 남겼으며, 장소·구도 풀을 '친구가 그냥 찍어준 일상 스냅' 기준으로 다시 썼습니다.
meta.mandatory_realism: Real skin with visible pores and small texture, light everyday makeup, no beauty retouching, no skin smoothing, no glow.
meta.mandatory_negative: No studio lighting, no bokeh, no cinematic colour grade, no HDR, no text, no watermark.
meta.revision_note_v3_ko: 기운님 지시 \"노출있는것도 만들어주고\" 반영. 수영복·짐웨어·호텔/료칸/리조트 맥락 전용 풀과 --mode glamour 를 추가했습니다. 섀도우밴 회피를 위해 언더웨어/란제리·성인 화보 어휘는 safety_banned_keywords 로 검사합니다.

person_shots.ko: 풀 계단에서 옆 사람 보며 웃는 컷
person_shots.en: She stands on the pool steps half turned towards the friend beside her who has just said something, head in profile, laughing openly, eyes squinting, not looking at the lens, one hand lifted in the middle of a gesture.

She stands slightly sideways in the full-length mirror with one hip out, holding the phone at chest height in one hand, the other hand resting on her waist; in the mirror the back of the phone is clearly visible with three big round lenses in a triangle — the newest model, not an old single-lens phone.
person_shots.phone_text: The phone is a current iPhone 16 Pro in natural titanium: large square camera plate on the upper left with three big round lenses in a triangle, a small flash and a LiDAR dot.

person_shots.ko: 호텔 침대에서 커피 들고 창밖 보기
person_shots.en: She sits on the edge of an unmade hotel bed with the duvet crumpled behind her, knees drawn up, both hands around a white ceramic cup of coffee, her head turned to look out of the tall window, a soft sleepy expression, not looking at the camera.

She sits sideways on the edge of the bed with her legs folded, leaning back against the wall, both hands raised gathering her hair up behind her head to tie it, elbows out, eyes half closed and away from the lens, a small tired smile.
She is walking away along the wet sand and turning her head back towards the friend, half her face hidden in her hair, half smiling, one arm swinging mid-step.

She sits on the floor with her legs folded to one side, holding the phone up with one hand at a slightly high angle, chin a bit low, smiling naturally at the screen, not posing, caught mid-expression.

person_shots.ko: 여름 거리를 걷다 옆을 보는 전신 스냅
person_shots.en: She is walking towards the camera but looking off to the side at a shop window, one hand pushing her hair back, the other holding a cold plastic bottle, body slightly off-centre in the frame.

She lies on her stomach on a white sunbed, propped up on her elbows, holding a tall glass of iced drink with a paper straw near her mouth, taking a sip, sunglasses pushed up on top of her head, looking at the friend.
